yavsos_azu_categories_pending: Categories are still loading, so categories in rules accept nothing yet. Try again in a moment.
yavsos_chip_always_tip: Accepted whatever the categories and filters say, and preferred over chests that accept it only by category, at the same priority.
yavsos_chip_category_tip: Every item in this category, unless a filter or Never says otherwise.
yavsos_chip_filters_only: Any item that matches the filters.
yavsos_chip_filters_only_always: Any item that matches the filters, and the Always items.
yavsos_chip_filters_only_tip: No category is ticked, so the filters alone decide: this chest accepts every item that matches them.
yavsos_chip_filters_tip: An item must match every filter. Rarity, upgrade level, damaged and crafter are tested on each stack as it moves.
yavsos_chip_ignored_tip: This rule names categories this game doesn't have (removed, or from other category settings). They accept nothing. The {{section}} section lists them.
yavsos_chip_never_only_tip: A rule with only Never items accepts nothing, so stashing puts nothing here. Tick a category or mark an item Always.
yavsos_chip_never_only_tip_azu: A rule with only Never items accepts nothing, so AzuAutoStore puts nothing here. Tick a category or mark an item Always.
yavsos_chip_never_tip: This chest never accepts it, whatever the categories say.
yavsos_chip_norule_anything: No rule: stashing can put anything here.
yavsos_chip_norule_anything_tip: AzuAutoStore's "{{setting}}" setting is off, so it stashes anything into chests without a rule, after the chests whose rules accept the item.
yavsos_chip_norule_cleanup_tip: {{button}} can move items out of a chest without a rule into a chest whose rule accepts them.
yavsos_chip_norule_existing: No rule: stashing adds only what's here.
yavsos_chip_norule_existing_tip: Stashing puts an item here only if this chest already holds some of it.
yavsos_chip_norule_unknown: No rule: AzuAutoStore works as usual.
yavsos_chip_norule_unknown_tip: AzuAutoStore stashes into this chest as it would without YAVSOS.
yavsos_chip_nothing_usable_tip: This rule has no part this YAVSOS version can use. Tick a category or mark an item Always.
yavsos_cleanup_azu_unreadable: Cleanup is off: YAVSOS can't read AzuAutoStore's exclusions. AzuAutoStore and chest rules still work.
yavsos_cleanup_button_tip: Moves misplaced items from chests within {{meters}} m to the chests whose rules accept them. A result panel lists what went where.
yavsos_cleanup_inventory_open: Close the inventory to clean up, or use {{button}} in the YAVSOS panel.
yavsos_cleanup_no_player: Cleanup needs a player in the world.
yavsos_cleanup_off_server: This server has turned off cleanup.
yavsos_cleanup_optout_tip: Cleanup leaves this chest's items where they are. You can still stash items here.
yavsos_cleanup_reader_broken: Cleanup is off: YAVSOS can't read inventories exactly in this game version (see the log).
yavsos_console_cleanup_help: cleanup [radius] - moves misplaced items to the nearby chests whose rules accept them
yavsos_copy_paste_tip: Gives this chest the copied rule.
yavsos_copy_paste_tip_empty: Copy a rule from another chest first, then paste it here.
yavsos_copy_paste_tip_in_use: Another player is using this chest. Paste once they close it.
yavsos_copy_paste_tip_label:
Gives this chest the copied rule:
{{label}}
yavsos_copy_tip: Copies this chest's rule: categories, Always and Never items, filters and priority. Paste it on another chest.
yavsos_copy_tip_hidden: Copies this chest's rule: categories, Always and Never items, filters and priority. Paste it on another chest. Parts this YAVSOS version can't show stay here.
yavsos_copy_tip_none: This chest has no rule to copy.
yavsos_edit_chest_in_use: Another player is using this chest. Try again once they close it.
yavsos_edit_exhausted: You can't edit this chest's rule anymore. Clear it and set it again.
yavsos_edit_invalid: A filter or value isn't valid, so the rule stays as it was.
yavsos_edit_loading: YAVSOS is loading its settings. Try again in a moment.
yavsos_edit_no_access: You don't have access to this chest.
yavsos_edit_no_player: This needs a player in the world.
yavsos_edit_not_eligible: This chest can't have a YAVSOS rule.
yavsos_edit_other_version: This rule is from another YAVSOS version or other category settings, so it stays as it was.
yavsos_edit_redo_changed: The rule changed after your undo, so you can't redo it.
yavsos_edit_rule_changed: The rule changed. Reopen the chest and try again.
yavsos_edit_too_large: The rule is too large to save (too many items or filters), so it stays as it was.
yavsos_edit_unconfirmed: YAVSOS couldn't confirm the change. Reopen the chest to see it.
yavsos_edit_undo_changed: The rule changed after your edit, so you can't undo it.
yavsos_edit_unknown_category: A ticked category no longer exists, so the rule stays as it was. Reopen the chest and try again.
yavsos_filtertab_filter_tip: Tick values to narrow the ticked categories. The values within one filter are alternatives; an item must match every filter that has a ticked value.
yavsos_filtertab_filter_tip_stack: Tick values to narrow the ticked categories. The values within one filter are alternatives; an item must match every filter that has a ticked value. YAVSOS tests this filter on each stack as it moves.
yavsos_filtertab_levels_unused_one: Saved level that none of these items reach: {{levels}}
yavsos_filtertab_levels_unused_other: Saved levels that none of these items reach: {{levels}}
yavsos_filtertab_none: No filter applies to these categories.
yavsos_grid_copies_one: {{count}} copy in the game ({{prefabs}}), such as NPC gear; a mark applies to it.
yavsos_grid_copies_other: {{count}} copies in the game ({{prefabs}}), such as NPC gear; a mark applies to all of them.
yavsos_grid_empty: Nothing here yet: tick categories, or search to add items.
yavsos_grid_here_one: In this chest or your inventory ({{count}})
yavsos_grid_here_other: In this chest or your inventory ({{count}})
yavsos_grid_kept_out: AzuAutoStore keeps it out of this chest type, so it won't stash it here.
yavsos_grid_mark_always: {{always}} here: accepted whatever this rule's filters say, and preferred over chests that accept it only by category, at the same priority.
yavsos_grid_mark_always_only: {{always}} here, although no ticked category accepts it.
yavsos_grid_missing: This item isn't in this game anymore.
yavsos_highlight_stays_full_one: {{items}} stays here: the chests that accept it are full
yavsos_highlight_stays_full_other: The chests that accept these are full, so they stay here: {{items}}
yavsos_highlight_stays_one: {{items}} stays here: no chest accepts it
yavsos_highlight_stays_other: No chest accepts these, so they stay here: {{items}}
yavsos_mark_azu_exclusions_changed: AzuAutoStore changed, so YAVSOS can't be sure which chest types its exclusions apply to. Cleanup moves items only into chest types without exclusions.
yavsos_mark_azu_exclusions_errors_one: YAVSOS couldn't read AzuAutoStore's exclusions in the last few minutes (see the log). Reading them has failed once this session. Until YAVSOS can read them, cleanup moves items only into chest types without exclusions.
yavsos_mark_azu_exclusions_errors_other: YAVSOS couldn't read AzuAutoStore's exclusions in the last few minutes (see the log). Reading them has failed {{count}} times this session. Until YAVSOS can read them, cleanup moves items only into chest types without exclusions.
yavsos_mark_azu_exclusions_unreadable: Cleanup is off: YAVSOS can't read AzuAutoStore's exclusions, so it can't tell which chests AzuAutoStore keeps items out of. Everything else works.
yavsos_mark_azu_kept_out_item: AzuAutoStore keeps {{item}} out of this chest type, so it won't stash it here. Its icon on the {{tab}} tab is amber. Use another chest type or change AzuAutoStore's settings.
yavsos_mark_azu_kept_out_one: AzuAutoStore keeps {{count}} of this rule's items out of this chest type ({{items}}), so it won't stash it here. Its icon on the {{tab}} tab is amber. Use another chest type or change AzuAutoStore's settings.
yavsos_mark_azu_kept_out_other: AzuAutoStore keeps {{count}} of this rule's items out of this chest type ({{items}}), so it won't stash them here. Their icons on the {{tab}} tab are amber. Use another chest type or change AzuAutoStore's settings.
yavsos_mark_azu_order: AzuAutoStore's stash key fills chests in YAVSOS's order: priority first, then the most specific rule.
yavsos_mark_azu_order_broken: AzuAutoStore changed, so YAVSOS can't choose which chests AzuAutoStore's stash key fills first. The stash key keeps AzuAutoStore's own order.
yavsos_mark_azu_pause: AzuAutoStore's pause key pauses ground pickup into nearby chests with a rule.
yavsos_mark_azu_pause_unreadable: YAVSOS can't read AzuAutoStore's pause key, so ground pickup may still fill chests while AzuAutoStore is paused.
yavsos_mark_azu_pickup: Ground pickup puts each item into the best chest whose rule accepts it.
yavsos_mark_azu_pickup_broken: AzuAutoStore changed, so YAVSOS can't choose the chest for ground pickup. Ground pickup keeps AzuAutoStore's own choice.
yavsos_mark_azu_rules: Chest rules apply to AzuAutoStore's stash key and ground pickup.
yavsos_mark_azu_rules_broken: AzuAutoStore changed, so YAVSOS can't apply chest rules to AzuAutoStore's stash key. AzuAutoStore keeps working on its own.
yavsos_mark_categories_from_game: This game's own category settings apply.
yavsos_mark_categories_gave_up: YAVSOS couldn't build the categories, so categories in rules accept nothing (see the log). Always and Never items still work. YAVSOS tries again every few minutes.
yavsos_mark_categories_loading: Categories are still loading. Always and Never items already work; categories work once they're ready.
yavsos_mark_categories_server_rejected: YAVSOS couldn't read the server's category settings, so categories in rules accept nothing (see the log). Always and Never items still work. The server and your game may have different YAVSOS versions.
yavsos_mark_categories_stale: The last update failed, so these are the categories from before the latest mod or settings change (see the log). YAVSOS tries again when mods or settings change.
yavsos_mark_cleanup_azu_unreadable: Cleanup is off: YAVSOS can't read AzuAutoStore's exclusions, so it can't tell which chests AzuAutoStore keeps items out of. See the AzuAutoStore mark.
yavsos_mark_cleanup_chests_unreadable: Cleanup is off: YAVSOS can't read chests in this game version (see the log).
yavsos_mark_cleanup_off: This server has turned off cleanup (the {{setting}} setting).
yavsos_mark_display_off_one: After an error, YAVSOS turned off {{parts}} (see the log). Restart the game to turn it back on. Chest rules, stashing and cleanup still work.
yavsos_mark_display_off_other: After an error, YAVSOS turned off {{parts}} (see the log). Restart the game to turn them back on. Chest rules, stashing and cleanup still work.
yavsos_mark_display_part_categories: the category line in item tooltips
yavsos_mark_display_part_glow: the chest glow after a stash or cleanup
yavsos_mark_display_part_results: the result panel (results still show as a message)
yavsos_mark_display_part_where: the "where it would go" line in item tooltips
yavsos_mark_drawers_broken: RossItemDrawers changed, so YAVSOS can't have AzuAutoStore fill empty drawers reserved for an item. Drawers keep working on their own.
yavsos_mark_drawers_no_azu: Empty drawers reserved for an item need AzuAutoStore, which isn't installed or isn't working with YAVSOS.
yavsos_mark_drawers_reserved: AzuAutoStore fills empty drawers reserved for an item.
yavsos_mark_epicloot_broken: EpicLoot changed, so YAVSOS can't read item rarity for the rarity filter. Everything else works.
yavsos_mark_epicloot_rarity: The rarity filter reads each item's rarity from EpicLoot.
yavsos_mark_muc_azu: Moves into and out of chests another player is using go through AzuAutoStore's copy of MultiUserChest.
yavsos_mark_muc_none: YAVSOS found no working copy of MultiUserChest, so cleanup and stashing skip chests another player is using.
yavsos_mark_muc_standalone: Moves into and out of chests another player is using go through MultiUserChest.
yavsos_mark_muc_yavsos: Moves into and out of chests another player is using go through YAVSOS's own copy of MultiUserChest.
yavsos_mark_server_without_yavsos: This server has no YAVSOS, so your own categories and settings apply.
yavsos_mark_stashing_chests_unreadable: Stashing is off: YAVSOS can't read chests in this game version (see the log).
yavsos_mark_stashing_off: This server has turned off stashing (the {{setting}} setting).
yavsos_mark_stashing_on: Press {{stash}} to stash into nearby chests, or {{stack}} on a stack to stash just that stack.
yavsos_mark_stashing_on_stack: Press {{stack}} on a stack to stash just that stack; no stash key is set.
yavsos_mark_stashing_on_stash: Press {{stash}} to stash into nearby chests; no stack key is set.
yavsos_mark_stashing_on_unbound: Stashing is on, but neither the stash key nor the stack key is set.
yavsos_notice_chests_unreadable: YAVSOS can't read chests in this game version, so chest rules, stashing and cleanup are off (see the log).
yavsos_notice_chests_unreadable_azu: YAVSOS can't read chests in this game version, so chest rules and cleanup are off (see the log). AzuAutoStore keeps stashing on its own.
yavsos_notice_panel_off: The YAVSOS panel is off (see the log). Chest rules, stashing and cleanup still work.
yavsos_panel_banner_in_use: Another player is using this chest. You can see its rule and edit it once they close it.
yavsos_panel_banner_unreadable: This rule is from another YAVSOS version or other category settings. Stashing puts nothing here until it's replaced.
yavsos_panel_banner_unreadable_azu: This rule is from another YAVSOS version or other category settings. AzuAutoStore puts nothing here until it's replaced.
yavsos_panel_fold_tip: Shows only the title, the status marks and the chest label. Every chest opens like this until you unfold the panel.
yavsos_panel_label_line_tip: What players see when they point at this chest. Unfold the panel to see or change its rule.
yavsos_panel_label_strip_tip: What players see when they point at this chest. Messages show here until your next action.
yavsos_panel_label_tip:
What players see when they point at this chest:
{{label}}
yavsos_panel_label_tip_hidden: Your {{setting}} setting is off, so you don't see chest labels.
yavsos_panel_label_tip_norule: This chest has no rule, so it has no chest label.
yavsos_priority_tip: Lower numbers fill first. At the same priority, the most specific rule fills first.
yavsos_priority_tip_norule:
Lower numbers fill first. At the same priority, the most specific rule fills first.
Priority is part of the rule, so set a rule first.
yavsos_reason_azu_excluded_types_more: AzuAutoStore keeps it out of {{types}} and other chest types
yavsos_reason_categories_loading: categories are still loading; try again in a moment
yavsos_reason_chest_limit_one: in a chest beyond the nearest chest with items; clean up again closer to it
yavsos_reason_chest_limit_other: in a chest beyond the nearest {{count}} with items; clean up again closer to it
yavsos_reason_muc_busy: another player's chest already has a request in this run; try again
yavsos_reason_muc_checking: another player's chest, and YAVSOS is still checking their MultiUserChest; try again in a moment
yavsos_reason_muc_format: another player's chest, and YAVSOS doesn't recognize their MultiUserChest's item format
yavsos_reason_muc_silent: another player's chest, and no MultiUserChest answered from their game
yavsos_reason_muc_unusable: another player's chest, and their MultiUserChest can't handle requests
yavsos_reason_no_muc: another player's chest, and MultiUserChest isn't available
yavsos_reason_unreadable: YAVSOS couldn't read its chest (see the log)
yavsos_redo_tip:
Puts back the change you undid:
{{rule}}
yavsos_redo_tip_in_use: Another player is using this chest. Redo once they close it.
yavsos_refusal_expired: you went too far away, or it took too long
yavsos_refusal_no_access: you don't have access to the chest
yavsos_refusal_owner_changed: a chest changed owner; try again
yavsos_refusal_policy_changed: rules or categories changed; try again
yavsos_refusal_unsupported: YAVSOS can't move this item safely
yavsos_result_range_one: YAVSOS read only {{nearest}} of {{count}} chest in range
yavsos_result_range_other: YAVSOS read only {{nearest}} of {{count}} chests in range
yavsos_result_title_stash_key: YAVSOS result for AzuAutoStore's stash key
yavsos_result_unreadable_one: YAVSOS couldn't read {{count}} nearby chest (see the log)
yavsos_result_unreadable_other: YAVSOS couldn't read {{count}} nearby chests (see the log)
yavsos_rule_clear_tip: Removes the whole rule, priority included, and this chest works without a rule again.
yavsos_run_busy: A stash or cleanup is already running.
yavsos_run_categories_loading: Categories are still loading. Try again in a moment.
yavsos_run_reader_checking: YAVSOS is still checking that it can read inventories. Try again in a moment.
yavsos_search_categories_tip: Search category and item names. The tree shows only what matches; point at a row to light up the nearby chests that hold it.
yavsos_search_items_tip: Search every item. The grid shows the items that match, and the nearby chests that hold them light up.
yavsos_search_status_none_accepts_one: No chest within {{meters}} m holds or accepts this.
yavsos_search_status_none_accepts_other: No chest within {{meters}} m holds or accepts these.
yavsos_search_status_none_one: No chest within {{meters}} m holds this.
yavsos_search_status_none_other: No chest within {{meters}} m holds these.
yavsos_search_takers: Also show chests that accept it
yavsos_search_takers_off: Off: only chests that hold a match light up. Click to also light the chests whose rules accept it.
yavsos_search_takers_on: On: chests whose rules accept a match light up too, in the accepts color. Chests that hold one keep the holds color. Click to light only the chests that hold it.
yavsos_setting_cleanup_range: How far from you, in meters, cleanup looks for chests. The server's {{setting}} caps it.
yavsos_setting_cleanup_shortcut: The cleanup key: it cleans up nearby chests. With AzuAutoStore installed, only this key's modifier counts: cleanup is that modifier (Ctrl if there is none) plus AzuAutoStore's stash key. Set it to None for no cleanup key; the {{button}} button still works.
yavsos_setting_controls_chestarrivaleffe: The small effect a chest plays when your stash or cleanup puts items into it. None turns it off. With AzuAutoStore installed, its stash key plays AzuAutoStore's own effect instead; cleanup still plays this one.
yavsos_setting_controls_highlightseconds: How many seconds chests stay lit. After you close a chest, its search keeps the chests it found lit this long, so you can walk to them; while the search is on, they stay lit anyway. After your stash or cleanup, the chests it put items into, or where something stays, light up this long. 0 turns the light off: search lights end when the chest closes, and a stash or cleanup only plays the effect chosen in {{setting}}.
yavsos_setting_controls_holdscolor: The color of chests that hold what you searched for, and of chests your stash or cleanup just put items into. Alpha is ignored.
yavsos_setting_controls_panelfolded: Show the YAVSOS panel folded: only its title, status marks and the chest label. The arrow left of the panel's title folds and unfolds it.
yavsos_setting_controls_paneloffsetx: Moves the YAVSOS panel to the right of its place beside the chest window, in the game's UI units (scaled to 1080p); a negative value moves it left. Drag the panel's title to change it, for example if it covers another mod's window.
yavsos_setting_controls_paneloffsety: Moves the YAVSOS panel down from the top of the chest window, in the game's UI units (scaled to 1080p); a negative value moves it up.
yavsos_setting_controls_resultpanelholdi: Keep the result panel up while your inventory is open; its countdown runs only while the inventory is closed. When this is off, the panel closes when the time in {{setting}} runs out, whether the inventory is open or not.
yavsos_setting_controls_resultpanelsecon: How many seconds the result panel stays up before it closes by itself. Its {{button}} button closes it sooner.
yavsos_setting_controls_searchshowstaker: Also light the chests whose rules accept what you search for, not only the chests that hold it. The tag button beside the search box ("{{button}}") turns this on and off.
yavsos_setting_controls_showchestlabels: Show the chest label when you point at a chest: its rule, such as "Food › eaten by Boar · priority 2 (Urgent)". It shows only on chests with a rule that you can open. A chest lit by your search or cleanup says why either way.
yavsos_setting_controls_showitemcategori: Add an item's categories to its tooltip, such as "Food ingredients, Animal feed · eaten by Boar, Hen".
yavsos_setting_controls_showresultpanel: After a cleanup or a stash, show the result panel: what moved and what stayed, with item names and reasons. With AzuAutoStore installed, it also shows after AzuAutoStore's stash key.
yavsos_setting_controls_showrulecontrols: Show the YAVSOS panel beside an open chest.
yavsos_setting_controls_stayscolor: The color of chests where something stays after your cleanup, because no chest accepts it or the chests that accept it are full. Alpha is ignored.
yavsos_setting_controls_takescolor: The color of chests whose rules accept what you searched for, shown while the tag button beside the search box ("{{button}}") is on. Alpha is ignored.
yavsos_setting_server_allowcleanup: Let players run cleanup, which moves misplaced items between nearby chests. Set by the server.
yavsos_setting_server_allowstashing: Let players stash with YAVSOS's stash key and stack key. With AzuAutoStore installed, AzuAutoStore does the stashing and this has no effect. Set by the server.
yavsos_setting_server_locksharedpolicy: While this is on, only server admins can change the server's shared settings (ServerSync decides who is an admin). It gives no one access to chests.
yavsos_setting_server_maximumchests: The most chests one cleanup or YAVSOS stash looks at, nearest first; the result says when more were in range. With AzuAutoStore installed, its stash key finds chests itself, so this limits cleanup only. Set by the server.
yavsos_setting_server_maximumrange: The largest range, in meters, a player can use for cleanup and for YAVSOS's own stash. With AzuAutoStore installed, its stash key uses its own range, so this limits cleanup only. Set by the server.
yavsos_setting_stash_azuautostore: AzuAutoStore is installed and does the stashing, so this setting is read-only and kept for when it's removed. {{description}}
yavsos_setting_stash_includehotbar: Also stash items from your hotbar (the first inventory row) with the stash key and the stack key. Equipped items, quest items and favorites from AzuExtendedPlayerInventory, Quick Stack Store or ItemFavoriteFramework are never stashed. Used only without AzuAutoStore, which applies its own "{{setting}}" setting.
yavsos_setting_stash_includequickslots: Also stash items from AzuExtendedPlayerInventory's quick slots with the stash key and the stack key. Used only without AzuAutoStore, which never stashes them.
yavsos_setting_stash_range: How far from you, in meters, the stash key and the stack key look for chests. The server's {{setting}} caps it. Used only without AzuAutoStore.
yavsos_setting_stash_shortcut: The stash key: it stashes items from your inventory into nearby chests whose rules accept them, and into chests without a rule that already hold them. Used only without AzuAutoStore.
yavsos_setting_stash_singleitemshortcut: The stack key: with your inventory open, it stashes the stack under the pointer into nearby chests. Used only without AzuAutoStore.
yavsos_stash_azu: AzuAutoStore does the stashing in this game.
yavsos_stash_categories_partial: Nothing stashed: categories are still loading. Until they're ready, chests accept only their Always items and items they already hold. Try again in a moment.
yavsos_stash_favorites_unreadable: YAVSOS couldn't read {{mod}}'s favorites and stashes them like other items (see the log)
yavsos_stash_inventory_open: Close the inventory to stash everything.
yavsos_stash_inventory_open_key: Close the inventory to stash everything, or press {{key}} on a stack to stash just that stack.
yavsos_stash_inventory_unreadable: Nothing stashed: YAVSOS couldn't read your inventory exactly (see the log).
yavsos_stash_no_player: Stashing needs a player in the world.
yavsos_stash_off_server: This server has turned off stashing.
yavsos_stash_reader_broken: Stashing is off: YAVSOS can't read inventories exactly in this game version (see the log).
yavsos_stash_single_favorite: {{item}} stays: it's a favorite in {{mod}}. Unfavorite it to stash it.

yavsos_suggest_always_tip_rule:

yavsos_suggest_set_tip_one: The one stack here is {{category}}. Gives this chest a rule that accepts {{category}}.
yavsos_suggest_set_tip_other: {{stacks}} of {{count}} stacks here are {{category}}. Gives this chest a rule that accepts {{category}}.
yavsos_tab_categories_tip: Tick the kinds of item this chest accepts. Search finds categories and items, and lights up the nearby chests that hold them.
yavsos_tab_filters_tip: Narrow the ticked categories. An item must match every filter that has a ticked value; the values within one filter are alternatives. YAVSOS tests rarity, upgrade level, damaged and crafter on each stack.
yavsos_tab_items_tip: Every item the rule accepts. Click an icon to make it {{always}} here, then {{never}} here, then clear it. A dimmed icon isn't accepted; an amber one is accepted by the rule, but AzuAutoStore keeps it out of this chest type. Search adds any item.
yavsos_tree_hidden_one: This rule has {{count}} more part this YAVSOS version can't show or edit. It stays until {{button}} removes it.
yavsos_tree_hidden_other: This rule has {{count}} more parts this YAVSOS version can't show or edit. They stay until {{button}} removes them.
yavsos_tree_ignored_category: Ignored category "{{id}}": this game doesn't have it
yavsos_tree_ignored_filter: Ignored filter "{{filter}}": this YAVSOS version doesn't have it
yavsos_tree_ignored_value: Ignored filter value "{{filter}}: {{value}}": this YAVSOS version doesn't have it
yavsos_tree_tip: Tick to accept the whole category. Point at a row to light up the nearby chests that hold it.
yavsos_tree_tip_shown:
Shown because something under it matches.
{{tip}}
